contract: #8084: with W held or auto-run on, Rocket Boots stops the character. Root cause is the same as Flame Step #6527: the 760384 LEAP_BACK knockback is a server-forced displacement that hands the client's movement over and drops auto-run. The fix keeps the same lunge only for a standing caster and otherwise carries the boost with a run-speed surge at the leap's own 15 yd/s for the 1s immunity window, leaving client movement untouched. This scenario pins the moving surge and its restore, plus that no forced spline displaces the fixture.
name: Rocket Boots leaves a moving caster's movement alone (#8084)

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Tinker knows Rocket Boots
Baseline distance to the dummy ahead
SETUP: the fixture starts at an unsurging run speed rate
Start moving forward, as auto-run or a held key does
DISCRIMINATING: the moving boost carries the caster with a run speed surge instead of a forced displacement
Let the surge run its course and any displacement finish
DISCRIMINATING: the moving cast left the caster where the client is steering it
The boost restored the run speed rate it borrowed
SETUP: the caster is still flagged as moving
SETUP: the Tinker is standing still
Rocket Boots is back from cooldown
